title: Thursday of the Ninth Week in Ordinary Time
summary: Ordinary Time continues with the steady work of discipleship.
description: This weekday keeps the Church in Ordinary Time after Trinity Sunday. The U.S. calendar does not list a required memorial for this date.
catholic_connection: Green marks Ordinary Time and points to growth in the Christian life: prayer, work, repentance, and charity.

title: Saint Boniface, Bishop and Martyr
summary: The Church honors Saint Boniface, remembered as a bishop and martyr.
description: The U.S. calendar keeps Saint Boniface as a memorial during the Ninth Week in Ordinary Time.
catholic_connection: Red is used for martyrs. The day turns attention to faithful witness that holds fast even under pressure.

title: Saturday of the Ninth Week in Ordinary Time
summary: Ordinary Time continues, with optional observances available.
description: The U.S. calendar lists this as a weekday. Saint Norbert, Bishop, or the Blessed Virgin Mary may be observed.
catholic_connection: Weekdays in Ordinary Time keep the Church grounded in ordinary fidelity and quiet conversion.

title: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ
summary: The Church gives solemn honor to Christ's gift of himself in the Eucharist.
description: In the United States, Corpus Christi is observed on this Sunday in 2026.
catholic_connection: White is used for celebrations of the Lord outside his Passion. This solemnity draws the Church back to Eucharistic worship and thanksgiving.
